description: Music develops your musicianship: performing and reading music, the families of instruments and how they make sound, listening and learning about music, teaching, composing or making an instrument, music and intellectual property, and music as a hobby or career.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. The 2026 update revised requirement 6.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Performing
requirements.summary: Singing or playing a song with good technique and reading the signs and terms of the score.

requirements.title: Instruments
requirements.summary: The groups of instruments and how they produce sound.

requirements.title: Exploring music
requirements.summary: Two options, such as attending performances, an interview, playing in a group or influential musicians.

requirements.title: Teaching, composing or making
requirements.summary: One option: teaching songs, composing a piece, or making and playing an instrument.

requirements.title: Music and intellectual property
requirements.summary: Intellectual property and how to obtain and share recorded music properly.

requirements.title: Careers or hobbies
requirements.summary: One option: a music career, or a hobby that uses these skills.
